skipped.message: BUG: ET.fromstring is unguarded, so a malformed arXiv reply is a 500, not a 502
BUG: _parse_entry assumes every field exists, so one incomplete entry fails the whole search
BUG: httpx.InvalidURL is not an httpx.HTTPError, so pdf.download lets it escape as a 500
SECURITY: pdf_url comes from the client and is fetched as-is, so the server can be aimed at any host (SSRF)
BUG: metadata.fallback reopens the unreadable PDF with no error handling, so a corrupt upload is a 500
BUG: the file is written before processing, so a failed upload leaves an orphan PDF behind
BUG: a network error reaching Gemini is not an LLMError, so the documented metadata fallback never runs
BUG: an id over 2^63-1 overflows SQLite's integer binding and becomes a 500
BUG: a stored path whose file is gone makes FileResponse raise, giving a 500 instead of a 404
BUG: the cached branch measures the raw text but a fresh summary measures it after stripping references
BUG: a network error reaching Gemini is uncaught, so the user gets a bare 500 instead of a readable 503
BUG: min_length is checked before strip(), so a blank question reaches Gemini and spends quota
BUG: titles with no Latin letters normalize to '', which also matches references that have no title
BUG: a non-Latin title has similarity 1.0 with any OpenAlex work whose title normalizes to ''
BUG: resp.json() is unguarded, so a 200 with a non-JSON body crashes GET /api/graph
BUG: resp.json() is unguarded, so a 200 with a non-JSON body crashes GET /api/graph
BUG: a 422 detail is a list, so the input (no maxlength) produces 'Search failed: [object Object]'
BUG: formulas are put back after DOMPurify runs, so math inside an HTML attribute breaks out of it and corrupts the sanitized DOM
BUG: the math placeholder isn't unique, so model text containing KATEXMATH99END renders as 'undefined'
BUG: math is extracted before Markdown runs, so $...$ inside a code span is rendered as a formula, not shown verbatim
